name: Azathioprine
dosing: Dose per indication; TPMT testing recommended prior to use
contraindications: Severe leukopenia or thrombocytopenia; known hypersensitivity; caution in pregnancy — specialist advice needed
interactions: Allopurinol markedly increases active metabolite levels — dose reductions of azathioprine required; interactions with other immunosuppressants and TPMT-related drugs
monitoring: Baseline and regular full blood counts and liver function tests; TPMT enzyme/activity testing before initiation to identify patients at increased risk of myelosuppression
pregnancy: Use only if benefits outweigh risks and after specialist discussion; limited data — specialist-led decision making
sideEffects: Myelosuppression (dose-limiting), hepatotoxicity, increased susceptibility to infections, possible long-term malignancy risk
clinicalPearls: Check TPMT status before starting; consider dose reduction or alternative therapy in patients with low TPMT activity; counsel about infection risk
indication: Immunosuppression for autoimmune diseases and for prevention of transplant rejection under specialist supervision
